cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Předat studentovi ucelený soubor informací o sběru biologických dat. Student se absolvováním předmětu seznámí s nejvýznamnějšími metodami sběru dat o populacích rostlin i živočichů. Kromě uvedeného si předmět klade za cíl, naučit studenta získaná data interpretovat a využívat v praxi profesní myslivosti.

Determination of presence signs of wild animals. (allowance 0/0)
Methods of collecting data on mammal populations - direct methods. Distribution of direct methods of wildlife census. Choosing the right method with an emphasis on practical use. (allowance 0/0)
Methods of collecting data on mammal populations - indirect methods. Distribution of direct methods of wildlife census. Choosing the right method with an emphasis on practical use. (allowance 0/0)

Methods of collecting data on populations of birds and other species of animals – methods of describing populations of birds considered and not considered game, methods of describing populations of other animals (insects, fish and amphibians). (allowance 0/0)

Experimental methods of collecting biological data - setting up and evaluating field experiments. (allowance 0/0)
Analysis of hunting statistics - trends in population abundance. (allowance 0/0)
Use of camera traps - development and current status of the use of camera traps for monitoring wild animals, including analysis of the data obtained. (allowance 0/0)
Use of GPS collars - development and current status of the use of camera traps for monitoring wild animals, including analysis of the obtained data. (allowance 0/0)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To give the student a comprehensive set of information about the collection of biological data. By completing the course, the student will become familiar with the most important methods of data collection on plant and animal populations. In addition to the above, the subject aims to teach the student to interpret and use the obtained data in the practice of professional hunting management.
